race.comment: FLYING CONCELLO (7) had a terrific prep earlier in the year after making the move from Victoria, winning 4 of her 5 starts in this prep, including a hat-trick to end the season. She has been burning up the trial tracks prior to her return, and though this field is very strong, she is weighted to continue her winning ways fresh up. BLAMEITONTHEBOOGIE (5) is a very progressive gelding resuming from a spell, and he too is very well placed fresh up on the minimum weight. He was behind the top pick in the same recent trial, and he is unbeaten in 3 starts fresh up in the past. Hard to beat. PRINCE OF KHATUN (6) will be chasing a hat-trick after winning both of his starts this season at Launceston. A wide gate is against time, but he has the fitness edge over the top 2, and should go close again. DURAZZO (1) won 3 stakes races last season, and is a winner of 11 out of 17 starts. He comes to hand quickly, but has to give weight to some smart types. He can still win this.
